english:
Landing enough weapon Hits within 5 seconds of each while <arc Bolt Charge /> is active prepares the next damage you deal from any source to grant a stack of <arc Bolt Charge />. Swapping weapons resets the counter. Dealing damage simultaneously can grant at most 1 stack.

Weapon Hits required to prepare a stack:
• 15% of Magazine Capacity, rounded down, plus 1
• Swords and Grenade Launchers: 2
• Sniper Rifles with a 3-round Magazine: 1

Each stack gained grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy, normally granting 25% across the 10 stacks needed to discharge. Ability sources that grant stacks beyond the discharge threshold still grant energy for every stack awarded: gaining 4 stacks while at 9 grants 10% Melee Ability Energy.

At 10 stacks, an ability hit or Unpowered Melee damage causes an <arc Arc /> bolt to discharge above the damaged enemy after 0.5 seconds. The discharge deals up to <pve 405 /> <pvp [36] /> bolt splash damage and <pve 270 /> <pvp [30] /> ground splash damage in a ? meter radius. This counts as generic <arc Arc /> damage, not ability damage.

The following can trigger a discharge:
• <void Volatile /> explosions
• <stasis Shattering /> a <stasis Frozen /> target, excluding automatic shatters on <link Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] />
• <strand Tangle /> explosions, <strand Threadlings />, and <strand Unraveling /> threads
• <strand Suspend /> snaps on <link Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] />
• <yellow Forerunner />'s The Rock

The following do not trigger a discharge:
• <arc Jolt /> chain lightning
• <solar Scorch />, <solar Ignitions />, and <stasis Crystal /> shatters from non-ability sources
• <yellow Gifted Conviction />'s explosives

source.text:
Upon scoring a Magazine-Based amount of Weapon Damage Instances within 5 seconds of each while Bolt Charge is active:
The next damage instance from any source will grant a stack of Bolt Charge.
Swapping weapons resets the counter. Can only gain up to 1 stack per simultaneous damage instance.

Damage instances needed to gain a stack:
(15% of Magazine, rounded down) + 1
Swords and GLs: 2
3-Ammo Snipers: 1

Gaining a Bolt Charge stack grants 2.5% Melee Ability Energy per Bolt Charge stack obtained, generally granting 25% Melee Ability Energy over the 10 stacks needed to discharge.
Acquiring over x10 stacks through abilities will still grant the corresponding Ability Gains (For example, being at x9 and acquiring x4 will still grant 10% Melee Energy)

After 0.5 seconds of scoring an Ability Hit or dealing Unpowered Melee Damage while at x10 Bolt Charge stacks:
Discharges an Arc Bolt over the damaged enemy, dealing up to 405 Bolt Splash + 270 Ground Splash = 675 Total [36 Bolt Splash + 30 Ground Splash] Arc Damage over ? meters.
Does not count as Ability Damage, only as Generic Arc Damage.

Triggers Discharge:
Volatile Explosions | Freeze Shatter (Not auto-shatter on Bosses) | Tangle Explosions | Threadlings | Unraveling Threads | Suspend Snap on Bosses | Forerunner's The Rock

Do NOT trigger Discharge:
 Jolt's Chain Lightning | Scorch and Ignitions (from Non-Abilities) | Crystal Shatter (from Non-Abilities) | Gifted Conviction's Explosives
